name: vault-personal
$acceptsComment: This vault is not a special kind of vault. It is an ordinary vault that happens to
accept private-life instead of professional - that is the whole difference.
'protected' is NOT a value that may appear here in any vault - it is an engine constant
so the ban cannot be configured away by editing a file inside a vault. Holding a
colleague's protected-category data on a personally-owned account reduces one exposure;
it does not make holding it appropriate.
$subjectsComment: Used only to disambiguate when more than one rostered vault accepts the same class.
Nothing else here accepts private-life today, so this list is currently unused.
$publishComment: This vault pushes to a private repository on a personally-owned GitHub account, so it
may carry 'private' - the tier that means 'one specific person'. That is a higher
ceiling than vault-spx's and it is not a loosening: it is the whole reason the roots
are separate. Private life reaches personally-controlled storage and nothing else.
'secret' still may not appear here. No remote receives that tier, on any account.
